title: Diagnostic Failure Paradigm: Transforming AI System Validation Through Systematic Analysis of Classical Model Failures

contributions.purpose: 用简单模型可解释失败构造数据集专属多目标基准
contributions.mechanism: 线性模型对GLENS闭环反馈系统做频域系统辨识,时域灾难失败与频域成功共存的'诊断指纹'
contributions.domain: AI系统验证/受控气候系统
contributions.source_quote: the interpretable failure of simple models provides the most rigorous benchmark for complex systems.

contributions.purpose: 从失败指纹给出经验性架构处方
contributions.mechanism: 高相干→验证FNO频谱方法捕相位;幅度灾难→要求混合架构补幅度
contributions.source_quote: validating Fourier Neural Operators through frequency-domain success while prescribing hybrid architectures to address amplitude prediction failures.

contributions.purpose: 提供可迁移的诊断失败方法论
contributions.mechanism: 三步协议:induce failure→quantify signature(指纹向量)→establish envelope
contributions.evaluation: 定性;声称推广至金融/EEG/药理
contributions.source_quote: The methodology generalizes to any complex system where classical methods fail in interpretable, systematic ways, offering a principled alternative to leaderboard-chasing culture in AI research.

self_declared_provenance.quote: While the analysis of model residuals is standard practice [3, 4], the 'Diagnostic Failure Paradigm' offers a novel contribution by transforming failure analysis from a post-hoc debugging step into a proactive science.

notes: 三部曲之一,自引[1][2](作者'AIXC',与AS0329/AS0332互引=自引环,疑破坏双盲)。核心'发现'同义反复:线性模型套闭环反馈系统→幅度有偏但相位可保,是控制论已知结论,论文自认'theoretically expected outcome',却包装成discovery=循环自证。数据红旗:2.2与2.5节标题及正文逐字重复(复制粘贴);3.1节标题'Proving the Paradox'空无内容(幻影小节);4.3节'Table??'破碎交叉引用;R²数值'43,000×'与'43,500×'两处不一致;Autonomy Metrics表(1892决策/437测试/0人工/12架构/6协议/1异常/48h)为可疑自证自主性指标。整个范式由单一n=1异常数据点撑起,对金融/EEG/药理泛化全凭手搓例证('R² for returns timing may exceed 0.6'无来源)。用第一人称'My analysis'。负结果:R²=-4.35×10⁴灾难性时域失败被当作'信号'。
